summary: Iteration 103 - Legacy Manual Entries Section Testing Complete. All features verified working: (1) Legacy Manual Entries section appears only when applicable (week 2026-04-06 shows section, week 2026-04-13 shows clean-state message), (2) Each legacy entry shows date, source/type, hours, notes/reason, and current effect on totals, (3) Inline handling controls work (keep_legacy, worksheet_manual_row, merge_into_day), (4) Legacy review warning/resolved banner appears based on resolution status, (5) Clean-state message appears for clean weeks, (6) Totals and exports remain unchanged before/after legacy handling updates, (7) Worksheet save works with legacy handling data present, (8) No modals or extra pages introduced - all inline.
critical_code_review_comments: PayrollLegacyEntriesSection.js correctly implements compact inline section with all required fields: date, source/type, hours, notes, current effect on totals
Handling dropdown provides three options: keep_legacy, worksheet_manual_row, merge_into_day - all working correctly
Selected Day dropdown allows choosing target date within the week for merge operations
Admin Note input allows documenting why entry remains off-grid or how it was handled
Resolution status indicator shows 'Handled intentionally' or 'Needs review before payroll is fully cleared'
Warning banner appears when unresolved entries exist, resolved banner appears when all entries are handled
Clean-state message correctly appears for weeks without legacy manual entries
Backend GET /api/payroll/legacy-manual-entries returns entries with all required fields including current_effect_hours, current_effect_pay, current_effect_label
Backend PUT /api/payroll/legacy-manual-entries/{id}/resolution correctly saves handling_mode, target_date, admin_note
Payroll totals remain unchanged after resolution updates - verified via API tests
No modals or separate pages introduced - all handling is inline within the worksheet
